File Info independently queries HTTP headers or FTP metadata when no transfer is active. Shows size and server MIME type (Windows file type fallback), supports More > Refresh details and draft login, and skips POST/media/partial jobs. The actual native dialog issued HEAD with prefetch disabled and preserved zero saved bytes; visual/DPI acceptance remains in F095.

Direct FTP supports validated resume, up to 32 fixed segments, cancellation, retries, active/passive modes and SHA-256 publication. Passive FTP also supports SOCKS4/4a/5 on control and data connections. Tested with fault injection and independent pyftpdlib. Other FTP proxy gaps remain in F079; size/time metadata is not a cryptographic identity.
Expected SHA-256 prevents publication of mismatched output.
Checkpoint contention, rollback and publication failure tests exist; real disk exhaustion/removable-device UI recovery remains unqualified.

Opt-in wake timers now cover one-time and daily/weekday/overnight queue starts, repetition and synchronization. Real Windows timer registration/signaling and app timed downloads/restart are tested while awake. Physical sleep/hibernate wake remains unqualified and depends on Windows policy/hardware; UDM must remain running. IDM documents the same running-app/wake-policy prerequisite.
Chromium and Firefox native messaging with persistent framing.

HTTP/HTTPS over Windows/PAC, HTTP proxy, SOCKS5 and SOCKS4/4a. Passive FTP now tunnels control and data through SOCKS4/4a/5, with remote destination DNS, separate logins, parallel/resume and no direct fallback. Explicit bypass permits direct FTP. Active FTP through SOCKS, FTP through HTTP/PAC, browser-specific proxy inheritance and per-protocol controls remain open. Shared SOCKS proxy-host lookup is cancellable; delayed DNS timing is not independently fault-injected.
HTTPS site/folder logins select the longest matching path at request time, including redirects; explicit per-file auth overrides them.
Global quota amount and 1–168 hour windows.
New jobs use selected temporary storage; existing parts retain their locations.
Scanner launch exists. No scan-verdict gating/quarantine workflow; exact reference behavior still requires observation.
Windows phone-book setup/properties/connect, opt-in shared automatic connection, retry/cancel and queue gating. Live success against a real modem/VPN remains unverified.
